description: caddis harness loop, auto-activated on install: relay.md session-resume injection (SessionStart + PreCompact), a session-end nudge + token-usage digest (Stop), a subagent dispatch/verdict log for agent-eval (SubagentStop -> .caddis/agent-log.jsonl), post-edit lint (PostToolUse on Edit/Write/MultiEdit), a rules-file budget re-warn (PostToolUse on Edit/Write/MultiEdit to an oversize AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md), and a deterministic safety guard (PreToolUse on Bash/PowerShell/Edit/Write/MultiEdit) that blocks secret/catastrophic writes and asks before destructive shell/lockfile/CI changes (escape hatch: .caddis/config.toml [guard] allow). All handlers are pure-Python and cross-platform; they require `python` on PATH.
